title: Novel green fabrication of stable hydrogel beads from industrial waste lignin for efficient Pb(II) ion removal
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,2255-2272
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00732H, Paper
Open Access

Xiwen Hu, Muhammad Amirul Islam, Aria Khalili, Amir Aghaei, Jae-Young Cho, Mohtada Sadrzadeh
A green method using liquid nitrogen produced gelatin–lignin beads with a Pb(II) adsorption capacity of 155 mg g−1, 96% removal efficiency, and stability over 10 cycles, offering a sustainable solution for water treatment.
